name: sistema-gestion-microcredito-p1
description: Núcleo de dominio del Sistema de Gestión de Microcrédito de Crédito Vecino, S. A.

scripts.test:mora: vitest run tests/politica-mora.test.ts tests/contrato-politica.test.ts tests/calculadora-mora.test.ts tests/regresion-p1.test.ts tests/contratos-p2.test.ts
scripts.test:invariantes: vitest run tests/invariantes.test.ts tests/cartera.test.ts tests/politica-mora.test.ts tests/contrato-politica.test.ts tests/regresion-p1.test.ts tests/gasto-gestion-cobro.test.ts tests/cartera-por-tramo.test.ts tests/pago-idempotencia.test.ts
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:backend && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/persistencia/ejecutar.mjs migrar
scripts.db:reset: npm run build:backend && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/persistencia/ejecutar.mjs reset
scripts.carga: npm run build:backend && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/persistencia/ejecutar.mjs carga
scripts.fase2:verificar: npm run verify && npm run test:carga:postgres && npm run build:backend && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/persistencia/ejecutar.mjs comprobar
scripts.api: npm run build:backend && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/persistencia/ejecutar.mjs migrar && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/api/principal.js
scripts.app: npm run web:build && npm run api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run web:build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.fase3:verificar: npm run verify && npm run test:carga:postgres && npm run test:e2e && npm run build:backend && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/persistencia/ejecutar.mjs comprobar
